title: TEA Server
description: Đây là Server TEA. Server sinh tồn với hệ thống tiền tệ khổng lồ
body:
🍵 TEA Server - Exclusive & Optimized Survival Experience
Welcome to TEA Server – a heavily customized Fabric survival server from the core. We proudly offer an ecosystem of exclusive features (Kyo mod series), designed to elevate your experience without requiring any client-side mod installation. Simply using the Vanilla version allows you to enjoy all the advanced systems below!

🌟 KEY FEATURES ONLY AVAILABLE AT TEA SERVER
💰 Breakthrough Economy & Trading System (Kyo Economy)
100% Server-Side UI: Experience the Admin Shop and Player Market through a smooth, intuitive inventory GUI.

Dual Currency (Coins & Coins): A perfectly balanced economy. Supports professional currency formatting systems (e.g., 1.2M, 15k).

Price Appraisal Machine: Smart pricing! Right-click on equipment to appraise its value based on enchantment tier, Shift + Right-click to quickly sell.

Price Fluctuation: Experience the thrill of investing with a system of item prices that randomly fluctuate in cycles like a stock market.

🎣 High-Level Fishing & Jackpot (Kyo Fishing)
Level System: Grind your fishing level with exclusive color cards (Especially for players Level 50+).

Jackpot: A chance to win a huge jackpot! Odds and rewards increase with fishing level and the "Luck of the Sea" enchantment.

Server-Wide Recognition: When someone wins a large jackpot, the entire server will receive a spectacular announcement with a tiered colored border, congratulatory message, sound effects, and particle effects.

Auto-Sell & Junk Filtering: The auto-sell feature frees up your hands by automatically selling fish and removing junk items.

⚔️ Kyo Event PvE & Bounty Hunting System
Diverse Challenges: Experience fierce random events such as Horse Trap, Siege Defense, and Raid Win.

Automatic Rewards: Complete survival challenges to instantly receive bounties directly into your Kyo Economy account.

🛠️ Kyo Anvil Upgrades
Repair Anvils: No more throwing away broken anvils! You can restore their durability using Iron Blocks.

Custom Savings: Repair costs (XP and materials) are rebalanced.

Colorful Name Changes: Supports players using Minecraft color codes to name items with vibrant colors that reflect their personality.

📊 Professional Interface & Display (Kyo UI)
Dynamic Scoreboard & TabList: Displays real-time metrics such as Ping, Playtime, and Kills/Deaths with colors that change according to status.

Custom Font Support: Integrates unique icons (like coins) directly on the screen.

TOP Leaderboard: A ranking system for the top 5 richest players, automatically displayed with vibrant prefixes.

🚀 JOIN NOW

Version: Minecraft 26.2

[Discord](discord.gg/thanh-long)

[Kyo Series](https://kyo-series-and-game.web.app/)

Join the TEA Server today to experience a vibrant economy and unlimited adventures!
